source_observations.name: FliteTest Phoenix model index, historical lead
source_observations.evidence: 2018 third-party guide links the index and describes Phoenix model ZIP files. A contemporary user claimed approximately 40 planes; not independently counted. Web retrieval currently leads to the forum home page rather than the model index, and no direct attachment was checked.

source_observations.name: FliteTest in Phoenix RC model index
source_observations.access_evidence: The search web fetcher rewrites this URL and returns the forum homepage rather than the thread. Individual archives not reached. Historical third-party forum instructions describe modelxx.zip folder contents, and another discussion describes several Bloody Baron versions and about 40 aircraft; do not treat counts or present access as verified.
source_observations.expected_test_value: Potential loose model-folder cases, with historical reports saying these are not standard .pkg installs.
